## Validation

List commands/platforms tested and any untested cases.

- [ ] Only synthetic fixtures; no credentials, real LDIF, personal data or private endpoints.
- [ ] Nothing internal in code, tests, docs, commit messages, comments or screenshots: no private host names or addresses, machine or home-directory paths, account names or links to private systems.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under Apache-2.0; third-party material is attributed.
- [ ] Security/TLS/keychain/redaction/CI changes are called out for maintainer review.
- [ ] `make check` (or the native Python check) passed; failures are explained.

Security vulnerabilities must use SECURITY.md, not this public PR.
